review_scope: Parent-assigned whole-task kernel-only review: complete forward/backward source and grid execution, independent arbitrary-Real/native references, actual Tensor argument and result observations, per-phase frames, ownership, physical separation, guard-derived safety and frozen evidence. Read-only inspection; no build or control rerun.

source_and_domain.correspondence: Read both complete actual JIT bodies and both readable DSL quotations, including optional seed/final-state/final-cotangent branches, every load/store/mask, reverse i>0 branch and forward pointer advances. Independently translated only quotation syntax and compared complete normalized ASTs; both hashes equal the frozen audit.
source_and_domain.guarded_domain: Ordinary contiguous FP32 CUDA [B,H,T,D], B/H/D positive, T including zero, optional [B,H,D] state/cotangent, current same device, resolved ordinary view flags, aligned contained storage and checked integer/pointer bounds. Nonzero storage offsets and readonly aliases remain admissible. BD is 32/64/128, with all 1/2/4/8 warp candidates retained; forward and backward may choose different tiles.
source_and_domain.historical_repair: The existing repair seeds reverse carry from dht when the final state was requested, visits reverse time through a nonnegative forward counter, and forms the previous-output pointer only at i>0. Outer h0.detach(), saved forward output identity, optional result and default fusion remain unchanged.

complete_source_grid_execution.source: Base.forward_split/backward_split are definitional decompositions of the single authoritative quotation. Execution.prologue/forward_step and BackwardExecution.backward_prologue/backward_step unfold the actual Structural source semantics. ForwardLoop and BackwardLoop construct successful complete loops, histories, carry invariants and every typed cell outside the write set.
complete_source_grid_execution.grid: Grid.gridRun invokes the actual complete body for each (channel block,batch-head) program. WholeGrid derives per-program values and input preservation; Whole.forward_grid/backward_grid cover the full programs list. The forward-produced Saved relation is passed to backward, rather than assumed at the public endpoint.
complete_source_grid_execution.public_result: Kernel.complete constructs f and b with both complete grids, every o/optional ht/dx/dg result, full forward and backward tagged-memory frames, Safety for both selected tiles and physical write separation. The public endpoints assume ordinary checked arguments and tile choices, not successful execution, a whole-result equation, a saved-output equality, or an allocator callback.
complete_source_grid_execution.empty_and_optional: T=0 executes initialization and optional ht storage, including the seed+0 operation; reverse has no time stores. Missing final cotangent selects zero carry. The previous state at backward t=0 is the original h0 load when present, with no accidental forward seed+0 substitution.

independent_references.real: Reference.state is the entry-input recurrence h[t+1]=g[t]*h[t]+x[t]. Reference.adjoint/dx/dg independently define reverse carry and gradients using entry do/dht. Gradient.pathState varies x/g while holding the seed fixed; loss_derivative proves the directional derivative of sum(do[t]*h[t+1])+dht*h[T]. Real input values are arbitrary and independent of raw-word interpretation.
independent_references.native: The same independently defined source-order reference constructs explicit Term add/mul graphs from entry raw-word leaves. Native.eval lowers these graphs under a value-independent topology schedule. NativeValues compares the executed result graphs to the independent reference under the concrete software FP32 operations. No reference calls source/grid execution or reads the computed final state.
independent_references.local_instruction_boundary: Native.LocalConformance has exactly three scalar laws: all-word addRN, mulRN and fmaRN equal the concrete FP.add/mul/fma .ieeeValue software operations. The software profile uses RNE, gradual underflow and canonical positive quiet NaN. There is no finite-input restriction, whole-recurrence oracle, whole-output port, or numerical-experiment premise.
independent_references.compiler_schedule: Native.Schedule reads only Shape (zero/region/address/operation topology), never input words. Kernel.profileSchedule explicitly represents the observed contracted and looped reverse families, retained seed+0 operand order, and forward FMA multiplication orientation. Selection is specialization-dependent; T alone does not determine it.
independent_references.saved_word_boundary: Every dg saved-state operand is evaluated to a word before mulRN. saved_rounding_boundary states that local instruction boundary. saved_word_reload proves that either observed profileSchedule can replace the saved graph by a leaf holding its evaluated forward word without changing the dg multiplication. This reload theorem is specifically for profileSchedule; the public arbitrary Schedule remains an explicit compiler model.

actual_tensor_observations_and_frames.input: KernelTensor.Arguments binds actual FP32.Tensor handles, object/device/dataPtr/shape/contiguous/negative/storageOffset observations and ordinary TensorLaws. Kernel.data reads the per-role entry observation at the actual pointer plus four times the source offset. Arguments has no value/output/success premise.
actual_tensor_observations_and_frames.coordinates: coordinates derives physicalIndex i=storageOffset+i and the actual storage address=dataPtr+4*i for each active logical element. logical_read proves equivalence to shared FP32.logicalValue. No zero-offset assumption is introduced.
actual_tensor_observations_and_frames.result: KernelTensor.result reads the executed typed memory through the actual Tensor physical index. resultWords observes that same executed memory at the actual pointer. result_logical and NativeTensorResult connect its evaluated raw words to shared FP32.logicalValue; output buffers are not independently populated with target formulas.
actual_tensor_observations_and_frames.phase_boundary: The memory parameter observes forward inputs and later backward cotangents at their respective kernel entry times. Forward never reads do/dht, and backward consumes the forward-produced saved o. Incoming cotangents may alias saved outputs; their entry observations remain inputs. This is the documented phase kernel relation, not a theorem constructing Torch callbacks or a unified final heap.
actual_tensor_observations_and_frames.frames_and_separation: The public Claim carries full tagged forward/backward frames and guard-derived unique ownership and physical separation for written words. Physical.key_bounds/key_disjoint establish contained aligned words and disjoint write keys; the preserved auxiliary finite-store frame/caller_frame lemmas protect entire readonly allocations at each phase. No new host/allocator or unified byteheap acceptance gate is needed.

source_index_safety.arithmetic: Bounds.forwardNodes/reverseNodes cover reached source arithmetic, padded lanes and forward final pointer endpoints. Safety derives exact signed32 representations from high<2^31, exact reached reverse subtraction, u64 formed pointers, aligned active storage containment, full grid coverage and unique writers.
source_index_safety.runtime: Grid-axis checks and current-device agreement are retained. Shared runtime grid-product compatibility/resource success stays outside this kernel-only scope, as disclosed by the packet.

frozen_compiler_evidence.generator_inspection: Read check_kernel_profiles.py as text. It captures actual canonical wrapper arguments with CPU-backed CUDA-metadata fixtures, selects actual autotuner configurations, uses create_function_from_signature and JITFunction._pack_args, and compiles the bound actual JIT source for an explicit SM80 target with default fusion.
frozen_compiler_evidence.independent_inspection: Independently read every pinned TTIR/PTX, checked target/source provenance and launch grid, and recounted bounded arithmetic opcodes after removing comments. All 64 maps equal the frozen audit, and no FTZ modifier is present. Representative operand inspection confirms seed+0, forward FMA, saved output word loads, contracted reverse carry and looped add/multiply.
frozen_compiler_evidence.special_case: T=3, BD=128, warps=1 keeps a reverse loop and separate add/mul; the other audited short reverse candidates contract. T=17/1024 reverse controls also retain separate add/mul.
frozen_compiler_evidence.limit: Bounded saved profile/binder evidence, not a universal compiler refinement, complete routing verification for every binary, native numerical conformance or GPU execution.

frozen_cpu_evidence.inspection: Read the complete checker and frozen log. The 150 paths comprise 144 combinations across all three BD values, four shapes including T=0 and partial tiles, optional seed/final/do/dht branches, plus six nonzero-offset/readonly-alias/saved-output-cotangent-alias controls. Eight forward and three backward rejects occur before kernel launch. The actual Python AST executes against CPU backing storage; results, caller storage, allocation tails, saved identities and the old ignored-final-cotangent defect are checked.
frozen_cpu_evidence.auxiliary_fixture_scope: The task checker is packet-pinned. Its imported fixture helpers and historical Python source were inspected and hashed during review below; these are current review observations, not retroactive claims that the original frozen CPU log pinned those helper versions.
frozen_cpu_evidence.boundary: These counts denote complete CPU paths, not a claimed GPU-launch count or native arithmetic validation. CUDA is mocked.

scope_boundaries: Three local scalar raw-word meanings and topology-only compiler scheduling are explicit model boundaries, not deferred numerical experiments.
Ordinary actual Tensor metadata/coordinate laws remain the representation boundary; Torch implementation, allocator/returned-object behavior and new host proofs remain outside scope.

Per-phase typed kernel observations and frames are the admitted scope. No unified final-byteheap gate, GPU experiment, FP-to-Real error bound, performance claim or universal binary/runtime conformance is added.
Task classification, canonical selection, integration and counts remain parent-owned.
